public_github_rest_ref_update.evidence: Current GitHub REST Update a reference request body exposes required new sha plus optional force. With force=false it rejects non-fast-forward movement, but there is no request field binding the mutation to one exact previously-read ref OID.
public_github_rest_ref_update.implication: force=false protects ancestry/fast-forward constraints, not an exact compare-and-swap against the caller's observed old head. A concurrent fast-forward can occur and a later fast-forward request can still succeed without proving no intervening ref movement.

public_github_graphql_updateRefs.evidence: Current GitHub GraphQL updateRefs accepts RefUpdate.beforeOid and afterOid and documents the list of ref updates as atomic: if any update is rejected, none are modified. beforeOid requires the ref to point at the specified OID before the update.
public_github_graphql_updateRefs.implication: Unlike Contents blob-sha CAS, beforeOid is a ref-history position precondition. It can express exact expected-old ref fencing and can cover multiple refs atomically.

connected_chat_github_surface.evidence: Connected GitHub action discovery in this run exposes update_ref(branch_name, sha, force) matching the REST shape, and exposes selected GraphQL review/PR mutations but no generic GraphQL executor or updateRefs/beforeOid mutation action.
connected_chat_github_surface.implication: The current Chat-connected GitHub surface can perform ref movement but cannot express the stronger public GitHub updateRefs exact-old-OID precondition. Therefore an end-to-end live history-bearing ref-CAS fixture is not safely expressible through the connected action set in this run.

comparison_to_live_contents_aba.contents_blob_sha: Current byte-identity CAS; live A -> B -> A restored the old blob SHA, so historical stale SHA became admissible again.
comparison_to_live_contents_aba.rest_ref_update_force_false: Ancestry guard; stronger than blind force but not exact expected-old CAS.
comparison_to_live_contents_aba.graphql_updateRefs_beforeOid: Exact expected-old ref OID with atomic multi-ref transaction; public capability exists but is absent from the connected Chat mutation surface.

execution_decision.reason: The only connected ref-write surface lacks expected-old OID and ref creation/movement is outside the path-scoped own-state mutation envelope used by this clean exploration. Mutating a branch would not prove the desired property and would expand scope unnecessarily.
execution_decision.note: This is a connector capability boundary, not a claim that GitHub itself lacks exact ref CAS.
